csrf.why: api.ts still uses $.post, so global.js's $.ajaxSetup CSRF header applies, and the message states the CSRF header is preserved.

401-redirect.why: Requests go through jQuery so the global ajaxError 401 handler still fires; the message says the 401 redirect to /login is preserved.

spinner.why: Requests use $.getJSON/$.post, so ajaxStart/ajaxStop still toggle #spinner; the message lists the spinner show/hide as preserved.

cache-false.why: GET still goes through $.getJSON, so $.ajaxSetup cache:false applies; the message lists cache:false as preserved.

interval-cleanup.why: useEffect returns () => clearInterval(timer), which clears the polling interval on unmount.

html-injection.why: Items render n.html via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, as before, and the message notes the raw-HTML injection and XSS risk is unchanged.
